title: Yoga for your teams' wellbeing
intro: Give your employees a moment to move, breathe and release the tension of everyday working life.
formats_line: Weekly sessions, one-off workshops and programmes adapted to your organisation.
points: Mobility after hours spent in front of a screen.
hr_title: Are you an HR lead or a manager?
hr_subtitle: What if you gave your teams a real moment to breathe?
hr_body: Working days are often driven by meetings, deadlines and constant demands.
Yoga can offer employees a different space: time to breathe, to get the body moving again and to re-centre.
I work with companies to offer Hatha Yoga sessions adapted to their organisation and to every level of practice.
formats: One-off workshops on breathing, mobility and relaxation.
cta_title: Would you like to organise a first session?
cta_body: Tell me about your project. We will talk about your needs, your premises and the right format for your teams.
cta_closing: Contact Jitendra to build your corporate yoga programme.
